t: Why he refused a marriage his own wife proposed
a: لَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ رَبِيبَتِي مَا حَلَّتْ لِي، أَرْضَعَتْنِي وَأَبَاهَا ثُوَيْبَةُ، فَلاَ تَعْرِضْنَ عَلَىَّ بَنَاتِكُنَّ وَلاَ أَخَوَاتِكُنَّ
p: Law lam takun rabībatī mā ḥallat lī, arḍaʿatnī wa abāhā Thuwaybah. Fa-lā taʿriḍna ʿalayya banātikunna wa lā akhawātikunn
m: Even if she were not my stepdaughter she would not be lawful for me. Thuwaybah nursed both me and her father. So do not offer me your daughters or your sisters.
